# Billing Module

## Overview
The billing module handles invoicing, payments, and subscription management.

## Key Decisions
- Uses Stripe as the primary payment provider
- Invoices are generated monthly on the 1st
- Supports automatic payment retry with 3 attempts

## Related
- See `latent/ADRs/` for architecture decisions
- See `latent/global/stripe/` for Stripe integration notes
